question: What is the canonical Q-adic filtration of the unmarked width-three and width-four connectivity Gram family at Q=1, and which associated-graded directions are seen by the already-tested mark response covectors?

scope.base_module: The circular noncrossing connectivity basis already used by the P333 exact certificates.
scope.gram_family: G(Q)_(pi,sigma)=Q^b(pi,sigma), where b is the exact join-block count and t=Q-1.
scope.marks: Only previously tested scalar falling-factorial responses, the width-three C3 charge-one landing doublet, the width-four C4 charge-one landing doublet, and the width-four C4 charge-two landing character.
scope.exclusions: No new mark, fitted endpoint column, width, Monte Carlo calculation, physical transfer claim or LCFT identification.

filtration_contract.lattice: V over Q[t] localized at (t), specialized at t=0.
filtration_contract.jantzen_layer: J^k consists of specialized vectors admitting a polynomial lift whose Gram image is divisible by t^k.
filtration_contract.invariant_factors: Record the t-valuations a_i of the local Smith factors; dim J^k/J^(k+1) is the number of a_i equal to k.
filtration_contract.first_order_stop: Let B span ker G(1). If B^T (dG/dt)(1) B is nonsingular, all positive valuations equal one, J^2=0, and no second or higher Gram coefficient is needed to identify the filtration.
filtration_contract.fallback: Only if that leading radical form is singular may the already-known exact polynomial G(1+t) be expanded further; no invented higher jet is allowed.

projection_contract.response: Each tested mark supplies its already-declared exact polynomial cross-Gram response c(t).
projection_contract.grade_one_functional: Restrict c(0) to J^1 using B^T c(0).
projection_contract.canonical_state_projection: When the leading radical form H=B^T G1 B is nonsingular, identify the functional with the unique associated-graded vector x satisfying H x=B^T c(0), and report exact rational coordinates and family rank.
projection_contract.sector_check: Verify the declared C3/C4 translation covariance exactly on the projected vectors.
projection_contract.interpretation: A nonzero projection means the response sees a base-family Jantzen direction; it does not construct a fixed-Q extension or repair an endpoint/Gram/source obstruction.

nilpotent_separation.base_parameter: Multiplication by t on the dual-number thickening V tensor Q[t]/(t^2) is the automatic square-zero Q-adic nilpotent.
nilpotent_separation.fixed_Q: After specialization t=0 this nilpotent acts trivially. Any fixed-Q marked extension must still satisfy its separately tested algebra, endpoint, radical, Gram and source constraints.
nilpotent_separation.decision_rule: Do not identify a Jantzen layer or nonzero mark projection with a physical Jordan/transfer nilpotent.

outputs.base: Exact G0 rank, leading-radical determinant/rank, invariant-factor valuations and associated-graded dimensions at each width.
outputs.marks: Exact B-basis functionals, H-dual state coordinates, span ranks and translation-sector residuals.
outputs.boundary: A machine-readable statement separating base-parameter thickening from fixed-Q extensions.

compute_contract.arithmetic: Python standard-library exact integers and fractions
